The front of the engine shows the crankshaft pulley, alternator, and serpentine belt system.
There are visible signs of wear, grime, and oil residue on the engine block and components.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the engine block or components in any photo.
Photo 2 shows a green 'P' mark on the top right of the engine block, possibly a workshop or seller mark, not a manufacturer mark.
The engine appears to be a 4-cylinder inline engine, likely from a passenger car, based on the layout and components.
No visible damage to the block or cylinder head, but internal condition is unknown.
